icon_zylinder.prompt: Stylized low-poly 3D illustration, app icon composition, isometric view from slightly above. One matte teal green 3D-printed cylinder stands on a small thin rounded slate-gray slab; the whole side wall of the cylinder is covered with a deep raised honeycomb relief of regular hexagons, like an embossed surface texture, the flat top of the cylinder is smooth. Next to it on the slab stands one small low-poly tree with a round faceted geodesic amber orange crown, flat-shaded triangular facets, warm brown faceted trunk. Matte surfaces, soft studio light from the upper left, soft shadow. Centered, the objects fill about two thirds of the frame. Plain flat very dark charcoal blue-black background, the same color at every edge. Clean, minimal, calm. No text, no letters, no logo, no watermark.
